title: When the Interior Turns
author: Lior Delacroix
blurb: Lior Dunmore, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a childhood home goes up for auction — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
